SELECT
									t.d_cdate,
									t.c_fundcode,
									t.c_agencyno,
									t.f_share,
									t.f_balance,
									t.f_oribalance,
									t.f_holdratio,
									t.f_managerfee,
									t.f_servicefare,
									t.f_income,
									t.f_reinvestshare,
									t.f_reinvestbalance,
									t.f_reinvestoribalance,
									t.f_outershares,
									t.f_outerbalance,
									t.f_innershares,
									t.f_innerbalance,
									t.f_serviceratio,
									t.d_lastservicefaredate,
									t.f_tailratio,
									t.f_tailfare,
									t.f_tailratio1,
									t.f_tailfare1,
									t.f_tailratio2,
									t.f_tailfare2,
									t.f_protectbalance,
									t.f_protectshares,
									t.f_totalmonthincome,
									t.f_cservicefare,
									t.inserttime,
									t.updatetime,
									t.batchno,
									t.tano,
									t.srcsys,
									t.f_investshare,
									t.f_investbalance,
									t.d_holddate
							FROM ${srcdbname}.hsta4_tsalestat t
							INNER JOIN ods.prod_product t1 on t.c_fundcode =t1.bk_product and t1.dk_is_money_fund='Y'
							where d_holddate between '${beg_date}' and '${end_date}'
